note: Vaishno Devi route ground truth from the GSI Preliminary Note on the 26.08.2025 Ardhkuwari disaster: 1 dated fatal event + 39 GSI-surveyed instability locations (DMS, Table-7.1) along Tarakot-Adhkuwari, Bhawan-Sanjichat-Adhkuwari, Himkoti Marg and Banganga-Adhkuwari. CAVEATS for scoring: points hug the track corridor (corridor-biased inventory, like Ramban's NH-44 set) and most are GSI-assessed VULNERABLE spots (incl. observed old failures), not all occurred slides. Every feature carrying a 'date' feeds the temporal back-test. 2026-07-07: +1 user_observed_vulnerable_location (Bhavan overhang, polygon in Research/Vaishno_Devi_Watchlist/) — lower evidentiary grade than the GSI points; filter by 'type' if a GSI-only score is wanted. 2026-07-11: +3 dated events (2008 Bhawan rockfall [GSI Spl.Pub.107 §5.4.4 — source-internal Aug/Dec date discrepancy, flagged], 2016 Bhawan complex failure [SMVDSB/THDCIL records], 21 Jul 2025 Banganga [press-verified, 3+ outlets]). EXCLUDED after verification: the '2 Sep 2025 new-track rockfall, 3 dead' claim from a deep-research synthesis — no press/GSI trace, and the yatra was closed 26 Aug-14 Sep 2025; treated as fabricated (see RESULTS_AND_KPIS §38).

properties.name: Banganga (Gulshan Ka Langar) landslide, old track
properties.trigger: heavy rain — Katra recorded 184.2 mm in the 24 h ending 08:30 IST 21 Jul 2025 (press)
properties.failure_type: Landslide/boulder fall onto the old track (booking office + overhead iron structure caved in)
properties.coord_confidence: anchored to Banganga locality on the old track (settlement-level, not GPS-precise)
properties.source: Press-verified 2026-07-11 across 3+ independent outlets (Kashmir Reader, The Kashmir Horizon, Greater Jammu, Deccan Herald; articles 21-22 Jul 2025) — date, casualties and the 184.2 mm/24 h figure consistent

properties.name: Bhawan rockfall at track km 11.550 (wedge failure)
properties.date_confidence: SOURCE-INTERNAL DISCREPANCY: the GSI Spl.Pub.107 §5.4.4 BODY says 30 Aug 2008 at 11:00 hrs (adopted — more specific); the section HEADING says 30 Dec 2008. Resolve via Kumar (2009a) before drawing any temporal conclusion from this event.
properties.failure_type: Rockfall by wedge failure in dolomitic limestone/cherty dolomite; source in the inaccessible escarpment >400 m above the heavily-inhabited foot-slope; bedding shear zone facilitated failure
properties.coord_confidence: anchored to the Bhawan complex (event at track km 11.550, foot-slope approaching the Shrine and Bhairon track)
properties.source: GSI Spl.Pub.107 §5.4.4 (p.127; page image read 2026-07-11) citing Kumar (2009a)

properties.name: Bhawan complex slope failure (track between elevator point and gate 5)
properties.trigger: heavy and continuous rain (per the primary source)
properties.failure_type: Rain-triggered landsliding damaging the track; aged Durga Bhawan building dismantled; slope subsequently stabilized (37 pre-stressed cable anchors, 26.5–30.5 m)
properties.source: PRIMARY-VERIFIED 2026-07-11: Naithani AK (2023) 'Assessment of the Various Slope Stabilization Initiatives...', Aspects Min Miner Sci AMMS.000775 p.6 (PDF in Research/Vaishno_Devi_Watchlist/); see RESULTS_AND_KPIS §34/§39

properties.name: Himkoti track RD 0/850 — GSI-assessed unstable slope (pilgrim-casualty history)
properties.failure_type: Wedge/topple in highly jointed cherty dolomite; dip-slope discontinuities (J2 daylights); slope ~67°, damage corridor 30–50 m, boulders 0.5–2 m (design case 5 m); rain-seepage lubrication mechanism
properties.history: Instability 'in recent past which lead to casualty to pilgrims' — event UNDATED in the source (pre-30.06.2017, the SMVDSB request letter date), so recorded as a vulnerable location, NOT a dated event (per the date-verification rule)
properties.source: GSI open-file report FS 2017-18, 'Landslide and Slope Stability Assessment of Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Himkoti Track' (Singh, Rana & Jungral), Item M4-LS/NC/NR/SU-JK/2017/12224 (PDF in Research/Vaishno_Devi_Watchlist/); RESULTS_AND_KPIS §39
